title: ExchangeEnvelope
description: Asynchronous transport envelope of the federated exchange. The only exchange type is publish: a node publishes the state of an object. The mode is determined by receiver_node_guid: absent — broadcast to group subscribers (full snapshot known to the sender); present — targeted delivery of the receiver's own contribution back to it (attributes with source_node_guid == receiver_node_guid, relations involving the receiver, and minimal object context).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of envelope generation

sender_node_guid.description: UUID of the sending node. Must match the federation_node_guid of the registered sender

receiver_node_guid.description: Mode switch. Absent/empty — broadcast: full snapshot of the object (all attributes with all source_node_guid known to the sender) to subscribers of the classification group. Present — targeted delivery: the card carries only the receiver's own contribution (attributes with source_node_guid == receiver_node_guid), relations involving the receiver, and minimal object context (guid, media, local_identifier, record_url)

objects.description: Digital object cards. Broadcast — full snapshot known to the sender; targeted — the receiver's own contribution plus minimal object context

persons.description: Persons (experts) referenced by the cards of this envelope — exchange context, not a global registry. Each person is owned by a node (its source_node_guid); full identity is the pair (federation_node_guid, person_guid)

relations.description: Record linkage relations carried by the envelope (e.g. same_as between cards with linkage status candidate_match / confirmed_match / rejected_match)
